import json, re, random, chess, time
RULES = [(re.compile(p), r) for p, r in json.load(open("re.json"))]
def run(fen):
    for p, r in RULES: fen = p.sub(r, fen)
    return fen.split("\n")
ex = "rnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P1Q2/P1P5/q4Kb1 w kq - 0 1"
exp = "rnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P1Q2/P1P1K3/q5b1 b kq - 0 0\nrnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P1Q2/P1P3K1/q5b1 b kq - 0 0\nrnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P4/P1P5/q2Q1Kb1 b kq - 0 0"
print(sorted(run(ex)) == sorted(exp.split("\n")))
def check(fen):
    ours = [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in run(fen)]
    b = chess.Board(fen); ref = set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN: continue
        c = b.copy(); c.push(m); ref.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    for x in ours:
        assert x in ref or x.rpartition(" ")[0]+" -" in ref, (fen, x, ref)
    assert len(ours) == len(ref), (fen, len(ours), len(ref))
random.seed(1); n = 0; t = time.time()
for g in range(400):
    b = chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over() and b.ply() < 300:
        if b.turn == chess.WHITE:
            check(b.fen()); n += 1
        moves = list(b.legal_moves)
        # bias toward captures/castling/ep/promotion
        sp = [m for m in moves if b.is_castling(m) or b.is_en_passant(m) or m.promotion]
        b.push(random.choice(sp) if sp and random.random() < .7 else random.choice(moves))
print("ok", n, "positions", time.time() - t, "s")
EOF
